metadata.title: Spawn Sub-Process
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create a sub-process from within a parent process with proper parent-child linking and sync point configuration.

template.description: Template to use for the sub-process

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the sub-process

syncPoint.description: When parent waits for sub-process completion

output.description: Sub-process created with parent reference, parent memory updated

specificActions: Determine Sub-Process Configuration: Identify template to use; gather parameters for the sub-process; determine sync point (when parent should wait)
Create Sub-Process: Use /process-new with the specified template; pass parent process path as context; sub-process memory will have parent reference
Update Parent Memory: Add entry to parent's 'Child Sub-Processes' table in memory.json with name, template, status=running, spawned at step, sync point
Handle Sync Point: If 'immediate', wait for sub-process to complete before continuing; if deferred ('step-N' or 'end'), continue parent process
bestPractices: Use 'immediate' sync for delegation (need result before continuing)
Use deferred sync for parallel work
Always record sync point so process-continue knows when to wait
Sub-process naming: include parent step number for traceability

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Recall the 5 Core Principles: LOG FIRST, READ JSON, STOP AT CHECKPOINTS, NO TODOS, VERIFY ACTIONS
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Determine sub-process template and parameters
substeps.description: Identify what template and parameters to use
actions: Identify template to use based on context
Gather parameters needed for the sub-process

substeps.name: Determine sync point
substeps.description: Decide when parent should wait for completion
actions: Determine sync point: 'immediate' (wait now), 'step-N' (wait at step N), or 'end' (wait at process end)

substeps.name: Create sub-process with parent context
actions: Pass parent process path as context
Sub-process memory will have parent reference set

substeps.name: Update parent memory with child reference
substeps.description: Add sub-process to parent's tracking table
actions: Add entry to parent's 'Child Sub-Processes' table:

substeps.name: Handle sync point (immediate wait or continue)
substeps.description: Either wait for completion or continue based on sync point
actions: If syncPoint is 'immediate': Wait for sub-process to complete before continuing
If syncPoint is deferred: Continue parent process, check completion at sync point later

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Determine template/params → Determine sync point → Create sub-process → Update parent memory → Handle sync (wait or continue)

memoryFileUsage.writeTo: Parent memory.json (add to Child Sub-Processes table), Sub-process memory.json (set parent reference)
